name: gl-rotate-scale-fade
title: Rotate_scale_fade transition
description: The outgoing image spins and zooms while fading to the incoming one, over a background color. Load vendor/glintmotion/hyper-shader.js, then this file, then call HyperShader.init({ transitions: [{ time, shader: "gl-rotate-scale-fade", duration }] }).
author: Fernando Kuteken
